---
title: "Data Structures Sandbox"
subtitle: "Code Editor + visualizations for data structures"
---

- **[Stack](pages/stack-sandbox.qmd)** -- run a function and watch each call land on the stack, then pop off when it returns.
- **[Queue](pages/queue-sandbox.qmd)** -- run a function and watch each call land on the queue, then pop off when it returns.
- **[List](pages/list-matrix-sandbox.qmd)** -- a list of nodes and edges, starting with a single row before seeing the whole list or the same graph as a grid of 0s and 1s, again starting with a single row before the full N x N matrix.
- **[Recursive Calls](pages/call-stack-tree-viz.qmd)** -- run a function and watch each call grow a node. Returned calls turn grey, with an arrow showing the value sent back.
- **[Recursive Call Stack](pages/call-stack-sandbox.qmd)** -- run a function and watch each call land on the call stack, then pop off when it returns.
- **[Graph Sandbox](pages/graph-sandbox.qmd)** -- a blank canvas with the full toolbar: add and delete nodes and edges, update labels, and select things to see them highlighted.
